The only slot that proves data moved

week-13 — a deliberate Key Vault operation, read back out of the workspace
# Compliance says a diagnostic setting EXISTS. This asks the workspace.

$ ... "AzureDiagnostics | summarize rows=count() by ResourceProvider, Category"

    MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT     AuditEvent   14 rows

$ ... "AzureDiagnostics | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, ResultSignature"

    2026-11-14T13:35:54Z       SecretGet        OK

    2026-11-14T13:34:53Z       SecretGet        OK
    2026-11-14T13:34:53Z       Authentication   Unauthorized

# A diagnostic setting only collects what happens AFTER it is active.
